title: Protocols, Generics, and Type Abstraction
learning_outcomes: Explain the role of protocols, generics, and type abstraction in Swift development.
Apply the module concepts in a small, inspectable Swift example.
Verify examples with a suitable local toolchain or a documented human review.

overview_visual.alt_text: Module 9: Protocols, Generics, and Type Abstraction. Lessons in order: Introduction to Protocols; Protocol Conformance; Protocol Extensions; Protocol Inheritance and Composition; Delegation and Protocol-Oriented Design; Generics Fundamentals; Generic Constraints; Associated Types; Opaque Types with some; Existential Types with any; Type Erasure; Conditional Conformance; Advanced Generic Design.
